verdict.rationale: Bento lets you create two core objects in plain English: failure-mode signals (it trains a detector from the description) and alert rules (which compile to trace queries). Operating the product more broadly by natural-language command is not documented. The CLI uses structured commands, and the Agent Skills give coding agents an integration playbook rather than a way to drive the product. Missing for 10: natural-language operation beyond signal and alert authoring (e.g., triage, querying runs, analytics), a documented agent or MCP path for controlling the product by NL, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe a failure mode in plain English. Bento trains a detector on your own traces, fires it in real time, and backfills your history.
Alerts are defined in plain natural language... Rules compile to trace queries and route to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or webhook.
